basis_statement: Audit events partition by the most specific continuity anchor first so nightly, authority, manifest, and workflow chains remain strict before falling back to family rails.

notes: Nightly chains remain distinct per batch and window.
This partition wins before manifest or workflow fallback.
Authority operations keep their own append-only continuity boundary.
Manifest-scoped execution stays in one strict stream even when merged review spans other families.
Workflow fallback applies when manifest identity is absent but workflow continuity still matters.
Family fallback keeps append-only law explicit for events without a more specific continuity anchor.

source_lineage.rationale: Defines the stream partition precedence for scrutiny-safe continuity.
